newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Major Czech shares ease at PSE daily price fixing.
newsitem.headline: Major Czech shares ease at PSE daily price fixing.

text.p: Major Czech shares, led by market heavyweights SPT Telecom and Komercni Banka, were mostly lower at the Prague Stock Exchange's daily price fixing on Wednesday.
SPT dropped 10 crowns while Komercni shed 11 crowns to help push the Reuters RPIX index down 3.2 points to 1,037.4 and the broader PX50 index down 0.3 points to 507.8.

Dealers said they expected the decline which started on Monday to continue for the rest of the week as foreign investors were on hold, waiting for prices to drop a further 3-5 percent before they re-enter the market.

Ceska Pojistovna shares fell 22 crowns to 2,778 and dealers said there was some concern that the firm may be hurt by recent flooding in the northeast of the country, where damages are expected to range in the tens of billions of crowns.
Pojistovna has said it does hold reinsurance to help cover any payouts it may make.
